rv.q: Pity the cast and creative team behind KNIGHTS OF THE ROSE, the new juke box musical at the Arts Theatre, which promised to be as fun as the stadium rock hits it featured. Those involved awoke the day after press night to a raft of brutal reviews. So how did this show misfire for so many critics and is there anything for you to enjoy?

The songs are performed carefully and none of the actors sound like they are straining or screeching, despite the rock style songs. Most of the songs are solos but the rare moments of duets or group numbers are excellent. In particular, the acapella versionrnof The Parting Glass and the dramatic song Is Nothing Sacred are brilliant.
